<!--
The three lists apaquarto builds for .docx, and the two it builds for the
pdf. Each entry reads "Figure 1. The Figure Caption", the same line in every
format, with the number not bold.

The contents is apaquarto's own rather than the field pandoc writes. Pandoc
puts that field at the top of the body, ahead of the title page, and no
filter can move it or turn it off -- --toc is fixed before any filter runs,
and the .docx writer never looks at the metadata, which a test of setting
meta.toc to false confirmed. So the contents is asked for by a name of
apaquarto's own, list-of-contents, and goes where typst puts it: after the
abstract, the impact statement, the keywords and the supplemental materials.
Building it here also settles which headings it carries -- the ones marked
unlisted are simply left out, rather than being fought out of Word's field.
-->

# A Heading Long Enough That Word Will Not Take Its Name

Word will not take a bookmark name of more than 40 characters, so pandoc
hashes a longer identifier and writes the sha1 with its first character
replaced by an X. A link has to ask for that name and not for the identifier,
or it points at nothing.
